FULL TEXT:
TRANSLATOR AND TRANSLATOR-CUM-PROOF READER (FOR SUVAS CELL)
RECRUITMENT EXAMINATION, 2024
CORRIGENDUM NOTICE
No.- 49/R&A Dated: 15th July, 2025
It is for information to all concerned that due to an inadvertent typographical error, the
serial no.51 has been typed as 52 in clause 6 of the Court’s notice no.47/R&A dated 11.07.2025.
As such, the clause 6 of the said notice be read as follows:
“The result in respect of the candidates whose names appeared at Serial
nos.1 to 51, 59 to 63 and 68 in the Court’s notice no.43/R&A dated 27.06.2025,
stands unaffected.”
By order of the Court
Sd/-
Registrar General
